title: Gingerbread House Christmas Clipart
author: vilaiporn.cha
description:
Bring the magic of the holidays to your creative projects with this Gingerbread House Christmas Clipart Bundle! This cozy collection features 30 high-resolution JPEG illustrations of charming gingerbread houses, jolly Santas, cheerful snowmen, festive trees, candy canes, and more — all perfect for Christmas crafts, cards, tags, wrapping papers, junk journals, and printable decor.
🎄 You Will Receive:
30 individual JPEG files
High resolution: 300 DPI
Size: approx. 3000px
Format: JPEG (non-transparent background)
Instant download – digital files only
✨ Perfect For:
Christmas card making
Holiday sticker sheets
Printable wall art
Scrapbooking & junk journals
Wrapping paper & gift tags
Kids’ party printables
Sublimation-ready artwork
🎁 These cozy gingerbread houses are illustrated in a festive, hand-painted style with snowy rooftops, peppermint candy trims, and heartwarming holiday charm. Great for crafters, teachers, small businesses, or anyone who loves cute seasonal art!
📌 Please Note:
This is a digital download. No physical item will be shipped.
Background is not transparent – JPEG format only.
For personal or small commercial use.
